/**
 * Resolved foo config.
 */
public interface FooConfig {
    public val enabled: Boolean

    public val limit: Int

    public val name: String
}

public inline fun FooConfig(
    crossinline enabled: () -> Boolean = { false },
    crossinline limit: () -> Int = { 10 },
    crossinline name: () -> String = { "a \"b\" ${'$'}c" },
): FooConfig = object : FooConfig {
    override val enabled: Boolean = enabled()

    override val limit: Int = limit()

    override val name: String = name()
}

public fun resolveFoo(
    local: FooLocalConfig,
    remote: RemoteConfig?,
    bucket: Lazy<Float>,
): FooConfig = FooConfig(
    enabled = { rolloutEnabled(remote?.pctFooEnabled, bucket) ?: local.isEnabled() },
    limit = { remote?.fooLimit ?: local.getLimit() },
    name = { remote?.fooName ?: "a \"b\" ${'$'}c" },
)
